capabilities: Open a fuzzy-search modal scoped to the current canvas
Match cards by note title or by note content
Shift canvas focus to the selected card
Toggle content search on or off in settings
extras: The README warns that searching note contents is not optimized and can be slow on very large canvases.
intentEvidence: use it to fuzzy-search and navigate within your canvas page
problem: On large canvases there is no quick way to search and jump to a specific card among many scattered notes.
summary: Fuzzy-search modal for the current canvas that finds note cards by title or content and shifts focus to the selected card.
